steps.clue: Shoot the four character tombstones in the required order.
Defend the Keeper Protector during its ritual, then collect and play the first audio reel.
Throw Li'l Arnies into all nine Apothicon holes, defeat the Margwas, then play the second audio reel.
Collect the six scattered bones, reconstruct S.O.P.H.I.A.’s body, then play the final audio reel.
Direct all four Corruption Engine lasers, then escort S.O.P.H.I.A. to Kino der Toten.
Teleport to Samantha’s bedroom, retrieve the Kronorium, then place it on the Kino stage.
Hatch the four Apothicon Eggs into Gateworms and retrieve the four Runes of Creation.
Enter the Kronorium symbols, survive the four enemy waves and recover the Summoning Key.
Strike the seven marked objects around the map with the Summoning Key.
Throw the Summoning Key at S.O.P.H.I.A., then seal the Shadowman inside the Apothicon.
